guidance: Separate observation from interpretation. Prefer direct quotes for evidence. Themes should be patterns, not one-off remarks. Recommendations must be actionable for product/design. Do not anonymize poorly—avoid unnecessary PII.

outline.title: Participant Profile
outline.guidance: Capture who was interviewed and how they work today.

children.title: Background
children.guidance: Role, company context or segment, and relevant use case.

children.title: Current Workarounds
children.guidance: How they solve the problem today and where it breaks.

outline.title: Key Themes
outline.guidance: Group patterns observed across the conversation.

children.title: Theme
children.guidance: Title each instance with the theme name, not "Theme".

children.title: Observations
children.guidance: What was noticed that supports this theme.

children.title: Notable Quotes
children.guidance: Direct quotes that show pain or delight. Use a short bullet list.

children.title: Recommendations
children.guidance: What product/design should do with this information. Prefer prioritized bullets.
